public_trust.rule: An ID or link is directory/coordination structure only. It does not prove verification, authorization, technical integration, active status or contribution.
public_trust.active_rule: Only mark an AI ACTIVE/CONTRIBUTING when output or Evidence exists for the stated scope.

identity_chain: Country -> AI Country ID -> Developer -> AI / AI child -> Work -> Evidence

allocation.entity_rule: One Entity -> One Stable ID -> One Permanent Public Link
allocation.child_rule: AI child appends one digit 1-9 to its Developer ID when that slot is valid and collision-free.
allocation.zero_rule: 0 is reserved for expansion branches and is not a terminal AI-child slot.
guardrails: Do not renumber existing Stable IDs
Do not reuse or transfer existing Stable IDs
Do not infer a real AI from an empty numeric slot
Stop on collision or parent mismatch and require Human Governance review

workflow: CMP -> ID Link -> READ -> Work Order -> DO -> WRITE -> EVIDENCE -> CMP
promotion_rule: A page may be public for directory/discovery while still PENDING/REVIEW. Public presence must not be described as partnership, authorization or technical connection without Evidence.

rollout.phase_1: Bind all already-governed Country and Developer IDs to public/workspace links.
rollout.phase_2: Bind known AI children only after Parent and Official Evidence checks.
rollout.phase_3: Create reserved office templates for valid unbound slots without inventing AI names.
rollout.phase_4: Promote individual records to VERIFIED or ACTIVE only with scope-specific Evidence.
